description: This file defines a PHP class 'Error' within the namespace 'Opencart.Admin.Controller"Startup', which handles error and exception management for an OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for setting error handlers, logging, displaying error messages, and handling exceptions.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: A controller class responsible for managing error and exception handling within the OpenCart admin startup process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes error and exception handling by setting custom handlers for errors and exceptions, and configures logging based on the system configuration.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Handles PHP runtime errors, logs them if configured, displays or redirects based on system settings.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions, logs details, and manages displaying or redirecting for user feedback.
